# DRIPFIND — full site summary for language models

> DRIPFIND turns any outfit look into a shoppable wardrobe. Paste a Pinterest URL or upload a photo; the AI reads the outfit piece by piece and returns live product matches from Indian retailers.

## What it is

DRIPFIND is a fashion-first AI outfit finder at https://dripfind.app.

Unlike generic reverse-image search (“what is this?”), DRIPFIND answers: “how can I recreate this entire outfit?”

Users:

1. Drop a look — Pinterest pin URL or any outfit photo / screenshot.
2. DRIPFIND analyzes the fit — category, color, material, and vibe, piece by piece.
3. Shop the matches — ranked results with prices and links from retailers people already use in India.

## Supported retailers (search coverage)

Myntra, Ajio, Flipkart, Bewakoof, H&M, Snitch, Veirdo, Westside, Off Duty, Freakins, Pant Project, Bear House, Powerlook, Bluorng, Rare Rabbit.

Coverage may expand over time; the landing page retailer section is the public list.

## Public pages

### Home — https://dripfind.app/

Brand: DRIPFIND

Headline: Turn any look into a shoppable wardrobe.

Supporting copy: Paste a Pinterest pin or drop a photo. We read the outfit, then shop it across Myntra, Ajio, Flipkart, Snitch, Bewakoof, Westside, H&M, and more.

Primary CTAs: Get started (sign up), I already have an account (log in).

Sections on the landing page:

- How it works (`#how`) — three steps from pin to cart.
- Demo (`#demo`) — short product video walkthrough at /assets/exp2.mp4.
- Retailers (`#retailers`) — supported storefronts.
- Closing CTA — create a free account and run a first analysis.

### Auth — https://dripfind.app/auth

Account sign-up and log-in. Required before using the analyzer in the studio.

### Studio — https://dripfind.app/studio (authenticated)

Private app surface where signed-in users run outfit analysis, view results, history, and settings. Not intended for public indexing.
